case.pattern_description: A shared-device fraud pattern was identified affecting multiple customers' cards. A single handset profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) was used across 28 different cards, each time appearing as a new device for purchases ranging from $92.16 to $184.19. This pattern matched four previously closed cases that could not be mapped to any known fraud typology. The fraud was detected by tracing card usage through transactions, devices, and cards in the TigerGraph database.

sar.narrative: Customer C06710, holder of card C06710-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-20 14:39 and 2016-12-02 10:38, 2 transaction(s) totalling $276.35 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $184.19 (3473057, 2016-11-20 14:39), $92.16 (3506095, 2016-12-02 10:38). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. The activity is suspicious because: Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert; 28 of them behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and 28 flagged as a New device. 4 closed case(s) on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, 4 of them recorded as an undocumented pattern. It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-2971, CC-3035, CC-2649. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
